focus: Source/test review of diagnostic rectangular-emitter partial-positive-incidence clipping, separation safety and bounded quadrature. Study production sampling excluded.

checks.name: startup and acceptance
checks.method: Read repository startup documents and m02-m03-code-v2 contract remotely
checks.result: Review respects declared numerical-reference tolerance, unchanged test thresholds, and distinction between source inspection and runtime acceptance.

checks.name: positive-incidence region
checks.method: Symbolic inspection of affine incidence nx*x + ny*y - offset and rectangle half-plane clipping
checks.result: Strict sign changes create intersections; boundary vertices carry zero contribution; wholly nonpositive faces return zero; wholly nonnegative faces retain the original 32x32 midpoint branch.

checks.name: quadrature and work bound
checks.method: Inspect convex polygon fan, Duffy map, Jacobian and integrand dimensions
checks.result: One half-plane clips a rectangle to at most five vertices and hence three triangles. Fixed 12x12 quadrature gives at most 432 partial-face evaluations. Positive barycentric vertex interpolation avoids signed-projection cancellation inside the clipped sliver. Integrand depth*incidence/r^4 times on-axis candela/area is consistent with the stated Lambertian irradiance model.

checks.name: separation and finite domain
checks.method: Trace LambertianRectangle validation, Position bounds, UnitDirection normalization, receiver plane guard and return order
checks.result: Finite bounded coordinates, dimensions and intensity precede evaluation. abs(depth) must be at least max(0.05, longestSide/4), even for zero output and backfaces; supported backfaces then return zero. Near-plane inputs abstain.

checks.name: diagnostic regressions
checks.result: Existing tests cover analytic parallel cases, independent off-axis Simpson references, narrow positive strips and corners, mirrored strips, tangent/away zero output, partial/full transition, near-plane invalidity, and far-field/intensity scaling. Numerical tests were inspected, not executed.

checks.name: neighboring test contract
checks.method: Read GrazingStudyContinuityTests.swift without reviewing Study implementation
checks.result: Independent slice reference, retained continuity counterexample and near-field/dark distinction remain represented in source; their runtime results are outside this review.

checks.name: frame integration
checks.method: Trace StudioPhotometry rectangle construction and EmitterFrame basis into diagnostic solver
checks.result: Caller uses validated optics and frame right/up vectors; right cross up agrees with emitting-normal convention.

limitations: Remote source-only review; no available host execution, Swift compilation, XCTest, scripts/agent_cycle.py check/next, benchmark or image review.
No fresh runtime, Debug/Release, native Metal, physical-device or milestone-acceptance claim.
Repository status, worktree changes and current branch were not inspectable through a local host; all source reads were pinned to the supplied base SHA.
Study sampling implementation was excluded; GrazingStudyContinuityTests was read only for adjacent contract context.
No source, test, tree, commit or ref changes; report upload uses only an unreferenced Git blob.
conclusion: No must-fix defect identified in the assigned diagnostic clipping/separation/quadrature scope by source inspection.
